cause_quote: The new `const referrer = new URL(document.referrer);` throws on WebKit’s empty referrer and aborts initialization before the sandbox can signal readiness.
user_saw: MCP Apps showed a blank panel and timed out in Safari and macOS WebKit.
summary: The sandbox now uses the browser-reported parent origin and falls back to the document referrer when the ancestor origin is unavailable.
reasoning: I checked the parent revision and confirmed that the Control UI already attached the iframe before navigating it, while the sandbox signaled readiness without a referrer and learned the parent origin from the first message sent by `window.parent`. PR #105728 made a valid referrer mandatory before signaling readiness, and PR #111687 carried that requirement into the shared sandbox.
